title: MeetingSource
description: One source of a meeting on the hosted store (decision 10): a capture, an import or an upload, with its transcript segments. Each upload of changed text is a new immutable revision; reviewed actions keep pointing at the revision their evidence came from. Text only: there is no audio field, and audio never goes to the server. A work meeting's source may carry its transcript too (decision 16); it is never published to AD Hub.

sourceID.description: Stable across revisions of the same capture or import.

revisionID.description: This revision. Evidence and analysis name it as transcriptRevisionID.

parentRevisionID.description: The revision this one replaces, if any.

engine.description: What made the transcript: whisperkit, recall, an importing tool's name.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale of the speech: en-US.

durationSeconds.description: How long the captured or imported recording ran.

transcript.description: Daybreak's Transcript, with every segment's id. Work meetings may carry one too (decision 16).
